en: Why did Paul want so badly to go to Rome?

text:
우리가 이제 세계사에서
흔히 이런 얘기를 하죠
en: In world history we often say:
This saying from the Middle Ages —

text:
유럽 전역에 *40만* 개의
출발점을 지도에 찍고

en: and traced the route to Rome.

text:
유럽의 거의 모든 길이
로마로 이어졌다는 거예요
en: almost every road in Europe led to Rome.
So why did Paul want to go to Rome?
To plant the gospel right here.
In the middle of dirty business, plant the gospel.
At the very heart of a fallen world,
Then the gospel spreads to the whole world.
